results.title: China ends 20-year wait for women's team gold at World Championships, secures LA 2028 berth
results.description: China won the women's team title at the 54th Artistic Gymnastics World Championships in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, on Wednesday, scoring 165.764 points to finish 0.233 points ahead of the United States.
